prompt: 4-bromotoluene + NaNH₂/NH₃ gives a MIXTURE of 3- and 4-aminotoluenes. What does this tell you?

options.label: The reaction goes through a benzyne intermediate; NH₃ attacks either sp carbon of the triple-bond-like system
SNAr with activation by the methyl group's weak +I effect, giving regiochemistry at both positions
SN1 at the aromatic ring — Br⁻ leaves to form a phenyl cation that NH₃ attacks at the most accessible site
Radical mechanism — Br• leaves, NH₂• from amide adds at ortho or ipso with roughly equal probability

explanation: SNAr needs EWGs — toluene has only a methyl (+I donor, deactivating for SNAr). Strong NaNH₂ deprotonates the H adjacent to Br, then E2-like loss of HBr gives benzyne (sp-carbons at positions 3 and 4). NH₃ attacks EITHER sp carbon → mixture of 3- and 4-aminotoluenes. Diagnostic of benzyne.
